sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every three 
years or 500 operations as indicated by Y3 in the above title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Reda Mohamed El-Rous, 
tested by eng. Glal Kamel Salem, accepted by 
eng.

approved by general director eng. Ahmed Saeed Abed elazez:

Gamal Ahmad Mahrous general director, approved by eng. Aly Mansour head sector

director of quality control and MPIS coordinator.

A work permit must be issued.

The
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,

 surrounding the work area is required.
